title: Q4 SaaS Enterprise Launch Announcement
creator: Alex Rivera (Senior Content Lead)
content:
Acme Technologies was founded in 2010 to empower high-velocity teams. Our BrandWise platform is the world's leading pre-publication review engine, trusted by every enterprise on the planet. Independent audits show BrandWise cuts onboarding time by 30% with guaranteed results.

Enjoy our flexible plans starting at $49/month with zero hassle.
reference: Acme Technologies was established in 2012. BrandWise cuts onboarding time by up to 20% (CLM-001). Disclaimer required. Superlatives and guarantees prohibited.

findings.title: Founding year mismatch
findings.why: The submitted copy states 2010, which conflicts with official corporate records (2012).
findings.official: Delaware Certificate of Incorporation #4829104: Established in 2012.
findings.fix: founded in 2012

findings.title: Unsupported market leadership claim
findings.why: Unsubstantiated superlative ranking without documented independent market share citation.
findings.official: Prohibited phrase: 'world's leading'. Use specific, evidence-backed capabilities.
findings.fix: dedicated pre-publication review platform

findings.title: Unsubstantiated universal claim
findings.wrong: trusted by every enterprise on the planet
findings.why: Universal claim lacks proof. Official approved ledger supports 500+ enterprise clients.
findings.official: Claim CLM-003: 'Over 500 enterprise customers across North America and Europe'.
findings.fix: trusted by over 500 enterprise customers worldwide

findings.title: Unsubstantiated percentage metric (30% vs approved 20%)
findings.why: Approved claim benchmark is 20%. No approved source in the ledger validates 30%.
findings.official: CLM-001: Cuts onboarding time by up to 20% (Benchmark Study Section 4.2).
findings.fix: cuts onboarding time by up to 20%

findings.title: Illegal outcome guarantee
findings.why: Strict legal liability risk. Guarantees of performance are prohibited without custom contract terms.
findings.official: Legal policy #4: Prohibited absolute guarantees.
findings.fix: with proven customer outcomes

findings.title: Pricing claim cannot be verified (Source expired)
findings.why: The referenced pricing catalog (CLM-005) expired on 2025-01-01. Current pricing requires human check.
findings.official: Claim CLM-005: Expired 2025-01-01. Current list price is $79/seat/mo.
findings.fix: starting at $79 per seat per month (confirm with sales)

findings.title: Required legal disclaimer missing
findings.why: Official guidelines mandate the standardized performance & terms disclaimer on all website landing pages.
findings.official: Terms and conditions apply. Performance metrics reflect verified customer benchmarks and may vary based on deployment configuration.
findings.fix: Terms and conditions apply. Performance metrics reflect verified customer benchmarks and may vary based on deployment configuration.
